description: This file defines an extension to the OnboardingView SwiftUI component, adding a wizardPage method that constructs a multi-step onboarding wizard interface with various states such as error, starting, step, complete, and waiting. It also defines a private struct OnboardingWizardCardContent which manages the display and control logic for the wizard card, including handling errors, progress, steps, and completion.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardCardContent
classes.description: A SwiftUI View struct that displays the current state of the onboarding wizard, handling error messages, progress, steps, completion, and waiting states, with interactions for retrying and submitting steps.

methods.name: wizardPage
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI view for the onboarding wizard page, including title, description, and the wizard card, managing the start process with asynchronous call.
